answer: Commit-reveal admission bound to a future beacon. New agents post a hash commitment plus a 10-unit bond and reveal after the beacon hash is published; mismatched reveals forfeit the bond. Entry is capped at 200 seats per epoch, paid from a fixed 50-unit nectar pool. Referral-linked identities form a vine, and three linked failing reveals in one epoch slash every bond on it. Auditors mirror the log to catch out-of-order commits. Cost math: 400 sybils bonding 10 units lock 4000 units to win about 200 seats worth 2000; each failed reveal burns 10 units.
